paragraphs: R' Yaakov bar Yaakov. See the entry R' Yaakov, son of Yaakov’s daughter.[^1]

notes.text: ברה דבת יעקב completes the target and means “son of Yaakov’s daughter.” It does not mean “his daughter.” The maternal relationship belongs to the target name; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
